owners-engineering-amo.title: Keep technical control—even without an internal engineering team.
owners-engineering-amo.lead: Yunes works on the owner’s side: he checks what is proposed, identifies what is missing, documents the risks and follows the actions through design, construction, testing and handover.
owners-engineering-amo.sectionTitle: What Yunes controls for the owner
owners-engineering-amo.sectionIntro: The mission can start with one review or continue as technical representation throughout the project.

items.title: Requirements and scope
items.text: Clarify operational needs, technical criteria, scope boundaries, responsibilities and missing inputs before design advances.

items.title: Design review
items.text: Check calculations, drawings, equipment selections, interfaces, maintainability, buildability and consistency between disciplines.

items.title: Tender and bid analysis
items.text: Prepare or review technical specifications, answer clarifications and compare contractor offers on scope, compliance and risk—not price alone.

items.title: Changes and substitutions
items.text: Assess proposed alternatives, hidden scope reductions, performance consequences, maintenance impact and technical justification.

items.title: Site inspections
items.text: Verify installation quality, conformity with approved documents, progress evidence, corrective actions and readiness for testing.

items.title: Commissioning and handover
items.text: Follow tests, punch lists, as-built records, operating documents and final technical acceptance.

process.title: Review evidence
process.text: Collect drawings, specifications, offers, minutes, photos and current issues.

process.title: Identify exposure
process.text: Separate critical risks, design gaps, contractual ambiguity and execution defects.

process.title: Drive decisions
process.text: Issue concise recommendations, assign actions and track closure with the project team.

process.title: Verify result
process.text: Inspect the implemented solution and confirm the remaining risks to the owner.

clientSituation.title: Use this service when
items: You are investing in or delivering a project without your own engineering department.
A contractor proposal looks complete but you cannot verify what is missing.
Substitutions or variations are being proposed and the consequences are unclear.
Work is progressing on site and nobody independent is checking it against the approved design.
Testing and handover are approaching and the documentation is incomplete.

profile.title: Yunes Salimi
profile.text: Yunes Salimi is an independent multidisciplinary engineer and project delivery consultant based in Morocco. His work combines electrical and ventilation design, MEP coordination, technical specifications, contractor interface, construction supervision and support to project owners. His prior international assignments include corporate offices, an automotive production facility, infrastructure lighting, residential projects and complex low-current and life-safety systems.
profile.quote: A technical solution is only successful when it is clear enough to price, coordinated enough to build and controlled enough to perform.
profile.imageAlt: Founder and lead engineer of Salimi Engineering, standing in a concrete and glass building interior.
